title: Marketing claim to review: cellulite (1 found)
detail: Rule family: ASA/CAP: no convincing evidence that devices or cosmetic treatments treat, remove or reduce cellulite or its appearance (any wording). A hint to review in context, not a legal finding.
evidence: r rear appeal, sculpt your curves, erase cellulite and tighten loose skin using the l
fix: Remove the claim unless you hold product-specific human-trial evidence; describe what the treatment involves, not an outcome.

title: Marketing claim to review: safest absolute (1 found)
detail: Rule family: CAP 3.1/3.7: 'safest', 'risk-free' and guarantees are absolute or comparative claims needing proof; ASA 2025 rulings held absolute safety claims trivialise risk. A hint to review in context, not a legal finding.
evidence: Booty Lift Lanarkshire offers the safest and fastest way to boost your rear
fix: Remove. If you say 'safe', qualify it and tie it to risk screening; never 'the safest'.

title: Street address not found in crawled page text
fix: Show the full address exactly as it appears on GBP.

title: Marketing claim to review: fake urgency (2 found)
detail: Rule family: CAP 1.3 (ASA rulings April 2025 on cosmetic-intervention ads) and DMCC Act unfair practices (false urgency). A hint to review in context, not a legal finding. Examples: 20% THIS MONTH. Only 4 slots left, offer ends tonight! Real results ga
evidence: BOOK NOW AND SAVE 20% THIS MONTH. Only 4 slots left, offer ends tonight! Real results
fix: Remove countdowns, 'last slots' and deadline pressure.

title: Marketing claim to review: medical claim by nonmedical (1 found)
detail: Rule family: CAP 3.1/12.1: registration, approval and 'proven' claims must be true and evidenced. A hint to review in context, not a legal finding.
evidence: no downtime and permanent results. Clinically proven. Detox your lymphatic system and g
fix: Remove unless you can evidence it; never imply NHS/regulator approval.

title: Marketing claim to review: permanent (1 found)
detail: Rule family: CAP 3.7/12.1: permanence of non-invasive results is unlikely to be substantiable. A hint to review in context, not a legal finding.
evidence: touring. Painless, no downtime and permanent results. Clinically proven. Detox your lym
fix: Remove 'permanent'/'lifetime' result claims; say results vary and may need maintenance.

title: No page targets 2 of 3 core services
detail: Intent-matched pages are how a local business earns organic traffic and gives AI assistants something specific to cite.
fix: Create one useful page per core service (own title, H1, price guidance, process, FAQs, local proof). Do not mass-produce near-duplicate area pages.

title: GBP name looks like a service keyword plus a place
detail: If this is not exactly the name on your signage, website and invoices, Google may treat it as keyword stuffing even though the profile was accepted.
fix: Confirm the permitted trading name with the owner/franchisor, make signage, website, Facebook and invoices match, and do NOT edit the GBP name in a hurry.

title: 'Wishaw' not in homepage title or H1
detail: Local relevance: make the service area explicit where users and crawlers look first.
fix: Work 'Wishaw' and the primary service into the title and H1 naturally.

title: No mobile viewport meta tag
fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">.

title: Marketing claim to review: skin tighten (2 found)
detail: Rule family: CAP 3.7/12.1: tightening/lifting claims need human-trial evidence for the specific device and body area. A hint to review in context, not a legal finding. Examples: t your curves, erase cellulite and tighten loose skin using the latest
evidence: fers the safest and fastest way to boost your rear appeal, sculpt your curves, erase celluli
fix: Say what the programme involves; avoid outcome claims without evidence.

title: Marketing claim to review: surg equiv volume (1 found)
detail: Rule family: CAP 3.1: implying surgical-equivalent results or added volume from a surface device is likely misleading. A hint to review in context, not a legal finding.
evidence: your lymphatic system and get the same results as a surgical BBL without the risks. BOOK NOW AND SA
fix: State that it is not comparable to surgery and does not add volume; avoid 'alternative to BBL' without a clear qualifier.

title: No suitability / contraindication information found
detail: Device treatments have contraindications (e.g. pregnancy, pacemakers or metal implants, clotting disorders). Say who should not have the treatment and that suitability is assessed first. [CLINICIAN] for the definitive list.

title: Business hours not set
Services/products not listed on GBP
No tap-to-call (tel:) link with the primary number
detail: Mobile local searchers frequently call directly.
fix: Make the phone number a tel: link.

title: Business name not found in page text
fix: Use the exact business name consistently in header, footer and contact page.

title: No LocalBusiness-type structured data found
detail: Structured data is hygiene that helps machines confirm name, address, phone and hours. Controlled tests show no citation uplift by itself, so do not expect it to rank you.
fix: Add JSON-LD using the most specific type (HealthAndBeautyBusiness). Run `python -m local_seo_agent schema <client>` to generate it from your facts.

title: No readable XML sitemap found
fix: Publish /sitemap.xml and reference it from robots.txt.

title: Marketing claim to review: before after cues (2 found)
detail: Rule family: ASA/CAP before-and-after guidance; CAP section 3 testimonial rules (numbering differs between editions: verify); UK GDPR for photos. A hint to review in context, not a legal finding. Examples: ends tonight! Real results gallery Before and after photos of our clie
evidence: 4 slots left, offer ends tonight! Real results gallery Before and after photos of
fix: Hold signed dated consent and unretouched originals; same lighting/pose; state sessions and interval.

title: Marketing claim to review: detox lymphatic (1 found)
detail: Rule family: CAP section 12: detox and medicinal-type claims need evidence. A hint to review in context, not a legal finding.
evidence: manent results. Clinically proven. Detox your lymphatic system and get the
fix: Remove detox/toxin claims; describe massage or lymphatic techniques factually.

title: Marketing claim to review: price inducement (1 found)
detail: Rule family: CAP 1.3 / GMC guidance on inducements (surgery); DMCC price rules. A hint to review in context, not a legal finding.
evidence: BL without the risks. BOOK NOW AND SAVE 20% THIS MONTH. Only 4 slots left, off
fix: Be careful with %-off, multi-buy and prize offers; state the total price clearly. Not for surgery or injectables.

title: Marketing claim to review: safe bare (2 found)
detail: Rule family: ASA 2025 rulings: 'safe', 'no downtime', 'painless' can trivialise risk; acceptable only as qualified, evidenced statements. A hint to review in context, not a legal finding. Examples: ough in body contouring. Painless, no downtime and permanent results.
evidence: l breakthrough in body contouring. Painless, no downtime and permanent results
fix: Describe what to expect honestly, including side effects and recovery.

title: Marketing claim to review: time pressure (2 found)
detail: Rule family: CAP 1.3 (documented for liquid-BBL/injectable ads) and consumer law; stricter for surgery and injectables. A hint to review in context, not a legal finding. Examples: 20% THIS MONTH. Only 4 slots left, offer ends tonight! Real results ga
evidence: a surgical BBL without the risks. BOOK NOW AND SAVE 20% THIS MONTH. Only 4 slots left,
fix: Avoid pressure tactics; give people time to decide.

title: No privacy policy link found
detail: UK GDPR requires a privacy notice where personal data is collected (forms, calls, tracking).

title: Analytics/advertising tags observed and no cookie/consent wording found
detail: PECR (UK): non-essential tags (ads, remarketing, call tracking; GA4 in default configuration likely does not meet the statistical exemption) generally need prior opt-in. This crawl cannot tell whether tags fire before consent; observed only. [LAWYER] for consent design.

title: Homepage has no canonical link
fix: Add <link rel="canonical"> pointing at the preferred URL.

title: Homepage has no meta description
fix: Write a unique, accurate description with city, services and a call to action.

title: No email address found on the site
detail: E-Commerce Regulations 2002 reg 6: an email address (not just a contact form) should be easily accessible.

title: CDN/WAF bot blocking cannot be detected from outside
detail: Cloudflare blocks AI bots by default on domains created since 2025-07-01. A spoofed user-agent test is unreliable because WAFs verify bots by IP.
fix: Check Cloudflare 'AI Crawl Control' / WAF settings and server logs for real OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot hits.

title: Directory NAP consistency requires manual verification
detail: We do not scrape directories (ToS). See the manual checklist in the plan.

title: Core Web Vitals field data not collected in this run
detail: Run with --psi and a PageSpeed API key to read CrUX field data. Small sites often have no field data.

title: Very little text on the homepage
detail: Not a ranking rule, but a page needs enough substance to answer what the business does, where and for whom.
fix: Say what you do, where you work, who it is for, how to book and why to trust you, using real details.

title: Profile verified 4 days ago: protect it, do not 'optimise' yet
detail: Do not change name, address and category together or in a hurry (re-review/suspension trigger reported by practitioners). The Business Profile API needs a verified listing 60+ days old: earliest application about 2026-11-28. Until then use the dashboard, Search Console and the Places API.

title: Very few reviews: build them steadily, compliantly
detail: Invite every customer the same neutral way. Avoid sudden spikes (Google filters new profiles' reviews more aggressively, per vendors), never incentivise, gate, or set staff quotas.

title: The local page lives on the franchisor's domain
detail: You share the site with every branch: you cannot control its claims or templates, near-duplicate branch content is possible, and the advertiser may be held responsible for claims on the page it links to. Audit the brand pages too and agree rules with the franchisor in writing. [LAWYER]
